Description: "Update Customer Name placeholder with asterisk indicator using user POS access level settings in App.jsx."
Instruction: "Update Customer Name placeholder in App.jsx to use POS Access Level permission settings"
ReplacementContent:
"                           <input
                             type="text"
                             id="customer-name-input"
                             placeholder={
                               (orderType === 'PICKUP' || orderType === 'DELIVERY') && (
                                 (subOrderType === 'DELIVERY' && getStaffPermissions()?.pos_access?.Delivery?.customer_details_mandatory === true) ||
                                 (subOrderType !== 'DELIVERY' && getStaffPermissions()?.pos_access?.Pickup?.customer_details_mandatory === true)
                               )
                                 ? "Customer Name *"
                                 : "Customer Name"
                             }"
